notes: The written `אֲשֶׁר` takes the subordinator *When*, a present morpheme taking its English before a supplied reading does (rules 11, 55); the italic *And* in the next colon is `added`, no conjunction standing there (rule 14).
`רֻקַּמְתִּי` → *curiously wrought* heads on *wrought*, the lexical predicate; heading on *curiously* is the named competing reading (rules 31, 8).
The article of `בַסֵּתֶר` is `unrepresented`: the ASV writes *in secret* with no *the* (rules 12, 29).
